v2-1768383849568-opl8natk9.name: Aridia
v2-1768383849568-opl8natk9.description: A vast, arid desert planet with a vibrant blue sky and monolithic geological formations.

v2-1768383849568-jitwpropr.name: The Great Expanse
v2-1768383849568-jitwpropr.description: A seemingly endless stretch of arid desert, characterized by towering rock formations and distant mesas.

v2-1768383849568-ck78ai9vs.name: The Chronos Pillar
v2-1768383849568-ck78ai9vs.description: A colossal, ancient-looking tower-like structure that seamlessly blends natural cracked orange-brown rock formations with futuristic, organic metallic architecture, featuring curved platforms, balconies, and windows with turquoise accents.

v2-1768386568474-1gg99e7qi.name: The Chronos Pillar Complex
v2-1768386568474-1gg99e7qi.description: The Chronos Pillar Complex is a monumental fusion of ancient earth and advanced alien technology. It serves as a nexus of exploration and scientific study within the Great Expanse.
forbiddenTransformations: rendering the exterior sky or horizon visible from within the main entrance hall
showing a transition to vastly different, non-integrated architectural styles
depicting the pillar's exterior as a backdrop visible through the interior space
introducing elements that suggest a natural cave system rather than a constructed interior
making the entrance appear small or low-ceilinged

v2-1768386568474-g2252no5r.name: Grand Vestibule
v2-1768386568474-g2252no5r.description: You have entered a vast, high-ceilinged vestibule carved into the base of the Chronos Pillar. The space seamlessly blends the raw, cracked rock of the pillar's foundation with polished metallic surfaces, illuminated by diffused, glowing light.

promptLayers.background: The far walls are a continuation of the cracked orange-brown rock, smoothed and polished in places, with sections of seamless, organically curved metallic plating extending upwards into the unseen height of the ceiling. Subtle, recessed turquoise lights are embedded along the upper architectural lines.
promptLayers.midground: The primary architectural elements are sweeping, metallic curves that merge with the natural rock. Archways and openings hint at further interior passages. Integrated platforms, also made of the same polished metal and rock, are visible at various heights, receding into the vastness of the space.
promptLayers.foreground: The floor is a polished, dark grey stone with subtle, crystalline inclusions, mirroring the arid ground outside but treated for interior use. The very edge of the massive, carved rock foundation of the pillar is visible, demonstrating the immense scale of the interior.
promptLayers.lighting: Soft, diffused light emanates from hidden sources within the metallic architecture and embedded turquoise accents, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the textures of the rock and metal. The harshness of the exterior sun is entirely absent, replaced by a warm, inviting glow.
promptLayers.atmosphere: An overwhelming sense of scale and awe pervades the space. The fusion of raw, ancient materials with sleek, organic technology creates a feeling of entering a sacred, technologically advanced chamber.

forbiddenTransformations: rendering the space as a simple cavern or cave
showing the exterior sky or natural horizon from within this hall
introducing elements of typical Earth architecture (e.g., modern doors, windows showing outside)
making the ceiling appear low or flat
depicting the metallic elements as sharp or angular
showing the raw, unfinished exterior rock face as the primary interior material
introducing artificial or overtly modern flooring materials that clash with the organic theme

v2-1768386657582-byqnkkbcr.name: The Terrace
v2-1768386657582-byqnkkbcr.description: You have arrived at the rooftop terrace bar. This elevated space offers sweeping vistas of the Great Expanse under the Aridian sun, with comfortable seating integrated into the pillar's architecture.

banned: visible interior walls not matching exterior texture
overhead structures that are not part of the pillar's design

promptLayers.background: The expansive, clear sky of Aridia stretching to the horizon of the Great Expanse. Distant, muted arid rock formations are visible under the bright midday sun.
promptLayers.midground: The main bar area and seating arrangements are integrated into the curved metallic and rock platforms of the pillar. Turquoise-accented windows reflect the intense sunlight. The organic metallic architecture flows seamlessly into areas of cracked orange-brown rock.
promptLayers.foreground: The polished, smooth surface of the terrace floor, perhaps with subtle integrated patterns. The edge of the elevated platform with a low, sculpted barrier that blends with the pillar's structure.
promptLayers.lighting: Bright, direct midday sunlight, creating strong specular highlights on metallic surfaces and warm illumination on rock. Turquoise accents glow with reflected light. Shadows are sharp and well-defined.
promptLayers.atmosphere: A sense of elevated freedom and wonder, with the harsh beauty of Aridia laid out below. The fusion of ancient rock and futuristic metal creates an awe-inspiring, distinctly sci-fi lounge experience.

forbiddenTransformations: The sky becoming unnaturally close or having visible cloud formations not consistent with Aridia's depiction.
The floor suddenly changing material to something that doesn't complement the rock and metal aesthetic.
Seating that appears as standard, mass-produced furniture.
Any architectural elements that look like they were bolted on as an afterthought, rather than organically integrated.
The turquoise accents losing their vibrant glow or appearing dull.
The presence of railings or barriers that look like generic safety equipment.
The sun's harshness being significantly softened or diffused.
